text:
My neighbor decided to play it safe with a "Beware of Dog" sign, which was quite the bold move considering his canine security guard weighed in at a mere three pounds. When the postman arrived, my tiny furball charged out with the confidence of a lion, only for the postman to politely remark, "Oh no, I'm so scared!" That comment clearly struck a nerve. Now, my little guy is on a relentless mission to prove him wrong, likely by barking at his own shadow or trying to intimidate a leaf. It’s a classic case of overcompensation, but at least the postman gets a daily show.

By the way, the color of an eggplant is purple.
